I have long admired GoTo Financial’s commitment to revolutionizing the digital ecosystem in Indonesia. As a QA Engineer with four years of dedicated experience in ensuring software excellence, I am eager to bring my expertise in automation testing to your engineering team to help maintain the high standards of reliability that GoTo users expect.

Throughout my career, I have transitioned from manual testing to architecting robust automation frameworks for both web and mobile platforms. My technical toolkit is directly aligned with your requirements; I have extensive experience using **Selenium** for web automation and **Playwright** to handle complex, modern web interactions. Additionally, I am highly proficient in using **Jest** for unit testing to ensure code quality at the earliest stages of development.

One of my core strengths lies in integrating these automated suites into **CI/CD pipelines**. I don't just write tests; I build seamless testing workflows that allow developers to deploy with confidence and speed. I understand that in a fast-paced fintech environment like GoTo, the ability to catch regressions instantly through automated gates is critical to preventing service disruptions.

I am excited by the prospect of applying my technical skills and my passion for quality to support GoTo Financial’s mission of driving financial inclusion. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in building scalable automation frameworks can contribute to the continued success of your development lifecycle.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
